macro.narrative: Re-verified Thu 23 Jul 07:00 SGT (pre-Asia-open) against the Wed 22 Jul US close; levels as of that close. The regime has firmed to a late-cycle risk-on melt-up: the S&P sits at a record ~7,509 and the Nasdaq ~25,837 after a semis-led breakout (~88% of ~66 reporters beating EPS), breadth is broadening (~69% of the S&P above its 200-DMA, best since February), and ~$120bn fled money-market cash into equities/credit last week (EM equities +$25bn, best since Apr-2025). CNN Fear&Greed at ~41 (Fear) diverges from the strong tape — cautious mood, greedy positioning. The single biggest cross-book driver is the Hormuz war premium (bullish oil + metals, hawkish for the Fed = headwind for HK tech, S-REITs, levered silver longer-term). Watch: Alphabet/Tesla/IBM earnings this week, next week's FOMC, and the 10 Nov China rare-earth control-suspension expiry after Lynas' Q4 miss.
